results.title: Minimal monomial decomposition moduli
results.question: Can all minimal ordinary decompositions of squarefree monomial tensors be parameterized up to their natural stabilizer action?
results.result: Classifies all shortest ordinary decompositions of the squarefree cubic tensor by projective sign choices.
results.scope: degree three and characteristic other than two

results.title: Matrix-space stabilizer counting from equivalence decision
results.question: Compute the exact left-right stabilizer order of a matrix space with polynomially many equivalence queries and polynomial-bit arithmetic.
results.result: Exact left-right stabilizer order by endomorphism-ring units and projective support symmetries.
results.scope: arbitrary finite-field matrix pencils, deterministic bit time

results.title: Matrix spaces of bounded maximum rank
results.question: Determine fixed-parameter bit complexity of left-right equivalence for spaces whose every matrix has rank at most r, seeking f(r) poly(N,log q).
results.result: Deterministic bit-polynomial recognition and left-right equivalence of matrix spaces of maximum rank at most two.
results.scope: all explicitly presented finite fields and arbitrary dimensions

results.title: TI_SL containment in TI
results.question: Construct a polynomial-time reduction from special-linear tensor isomorphism to ordinary GL tensor isomorphism, with explicit arrays of polynomial size and exact equivalence.
results.result: Special-linear TI reduces to ordinary TI in deterministic polynomial time whenever one slice space has maximum rank at most two.
results.scope: certified slice upper rank two over explicit finite fields

results.title: Prime versus extension-field TI
results.question: Determine polynomial-reduction relationships between TI over F_p and TI over F_(p^e), uniformly in e and log p, preserving base-field rather than extension-field orbits.
results.result: Exact reductions between ordinary tensor isomorphism over a prime field and its finite extensions.
results.scope: extension-to-prime uniform in field size, reverse at fixed characteristic

results.title: Projective lifts of matroid automorphisms
results.question: Given a matrix representation of a matroid and generators of its abstract automorphism group, compute the image of the monomial code automorphism group on the coordinates in polynomial bit time.
results.result: Computes the image, lifts and order of the monomial automorphism group.
results.scope: supplied abstract matroid automorphisms, parameterized by field size and maximum component cycle rank

results.title: Epimorphism between central extensions of a shared simple quotient
results.question: For compact perfect-group presentations with an explicitly supplied common nonabelian simple quotient and central kernel bases, determine polynomial-bit-time decision under arbitrary automorphisms of that quotient.
results.result: Decides and counts central epimorphisms over all automorphisms of a nonabelian simple quotient.
results.scope: compact perfect extensions over a displayed quotient table

results.title: Surjectivity to a fixed class-two torsion-free nilpotent group
results.question: Classify existence of epimorphisms from arbitrary finitely presented groups to a fixed nonabelian torsion-free class-two nilpotent group in terms of its commutator form and integral lattice.
results.result: Integral alternating invariant factors and torsion divisibilities decide epimorphism onto a cyclic-derived torsion-free target.
results.scope: source class-two quotient with derived rank at most one

results.title: Parallel minimum normal faithful degree
results.question: For permutation-generator groups, compute in NC the minimum degree of a faithful G-set all of whose point stabilizers are normal, or establish a lower bound for this restriction.
results.result: Alternating-form ranks give the optimal faithful degree with normal point stabilizers, with parallel evaluation under a small derived subgroup promise.
results.scope: class two and odd prime exponent

results.title: Exact short descriptions of complement conjugacy classes
results.question: For a soluble compact group and a characteristic normal p-subgroup of class two, count conjugacy classes of complements without explicitly enumerating each complement.
results.result: Exact formulas count complements and their conjugacy classes and construct a complement.
results.scope: extraspecial normal kernel in a class-two odd prime exponent group

results.title: Counting degree-preserving conjugations of partially identified actions
results.question: Given a family of compact subgroups and matching correspondence of selected orbits, count the permutations carrying each source group to its designated partner while respecting the orbit correspondence.
results.result: Counts simultaneous conjugators of compact group lists across partially matched prime regular orbits.
results.scope: collective cyclic regular prime orbit actions

results.title: Canonical Schreier representatives with small circuit depth
results.question: Find an NC algorithm producing a complete transversal of a permutation subgroup in a supergroup when the index is supplied in unary and coset order must depend only on the represented labeled groups.
results.result: Logspace-uniform NC constructs a generator-independent ordered Schreier transversal.
results.scope: elementary abelian ambient permutation action and unary index
results.verification: written proof with two Lean-checked identities

results.title: Simultaneous isomorphism of multiple Latin operations
results.question: For one common finite domain, compare two variable-length lists of Latin operations under one shared bijection using polynomial time when each operation is individually group-isotopic and has a displayed isotope.
results.result: Joint isomorphism of any number of Latin operations is decidable in polynomial time with hidden common coordinates.
results.scope: common elementary abelian affine structure on each domain

results.title: Constant-individual-degree sparse factor closure
results.question: Are all factors of constant-individual-degree sparse polynomials polynomially sparse in the original sparsity?
results.result: Bounds factor sparsity by the input sparsity times a product controlled by higher-degree shared variables.
results.scope: arbitrary fields, polynomial bound at fixed degree and logarithmically many higher-degree shared variables

results.title: Field-preserving exact recovery of border circuits
results.question: Given a symbolic rational one-parameter depth-three representation with polynomial bit length and very large pole order, recover an exact circuit for its polynomial limit in deterministic time polynomial in input and target circuit sizes.
results.result: Extracts exact limit circuits for depth-three inputs with exponentially large binary pole orders.
results.scope: bounded number of common Laurent exponent generators

results.title: CNFs hard for nonlinear-placeholder roABP-IPS
results.question: Do explicit unsatisfiable 3-CNFs require superpolynomial size when the certificate is a roABP that may have genuine nonlinear dependence on the equation placeholders and may choose its order?
results.result: Constructs constant-width ordinary and geometric placeholder IPS for inconsistent XOR constraints.
results.scope: bounded-arity XOR CNFs

results.title: DAG-reuse simulation in roABP-IPS
results.question: Does linear-coefficient roABP-IPS p-simulate DAG-like Polynomial Calculus measured in line count, without converting the derivation to a tree?
results.result: Constructs same-order linear ROABP-IPS from DAG-like Polynomial Calculus.
results.scope: bounded pathwidth of labeled incidence graph

results.title: Direct sharp counting-class bound for algebraic solution counting
results.question: Determine the counting-class complexity of the finite number of geometric zeros of a rational polynomial system, with infinity reported separately when the solution set is positive-dimensional.
results.result: Classifies distinct geometric zero counting and gives short infinity certificates.
results.scope: overdetermined sparse binomial systems over rationals and finite fields

results.title: Hilbert Nullstellensatz over fixed finite fields below the counting hierarchy
results.question: Place algebraic-closure feasibility for polynomial systems over fixed F_p in a fixed class below the full counting hierarchy, with a direct bit-complexity proof.
results.result: Decides feasibility and counts geometric solutions for compressed additive Frobenius systems.
results.scope: additive equations and binary Frobenius indices

results.title: Minimal data determining an intersection array
results.question: Determine the minimum m(r) such that m(r) nonzero intersection numbers suffice to determine all intersection numbers of any rank-r coherent configuration.
results.result: Reconstructs the intersection table from selected positive entries on a supplied generating set of basis relations.
results.scope: named generators and labeled fibers

results.title: Multiplicity characterization against arbitrary graph competitors
results.question: Does the full automorphism cycle index of a symmetry-characterized graph identify it, up to complementation and identifying empty with complete graphs, against an arbitrary competing graph on the same vertex set?
results.result: Classifies the transposition case of symmetry-characterized graphs and separates full cycle indices up to complementation.
results.scope: restricted automorphism family

results.title: Axiom-independent quantum matroid isomorphism
results.question: Determine whether quantum matroid isomorphism defined using bases, circuits, or independent sets gives the same equivalence relation, and establish a universal definition or explicit separation.
results.result: Pointed independent-set quantum isomorphism equals ordinary matroid isomorphism.
results.scope: loopless matroids, also pointed bases through rank three

results.title: Finite-dimensional realization bound from small coherent modules
results.question: Find a computable bound on the Hilbert-space dimension of a quantum isomorphism witness under a stated bound on the multiplicities of the coherent-algebra simple modules, or refute such a bound.
results.result: Dimension-preserving reduction to ordinary uncolored graph quantum isomorphism, yielding no computable finite witness cap.
results.scope: coherent multiplicity at most four

results.title: Near-linear hypergraph canonization with bounded incidence treewidth
results.question: Produce a uniform canonical-labeling algorithm with f(t) near-linear incidence-input complexity, where t is incidence-treewidth, without noncanonical choices of edge or vertex representatives.
results.result: Near-linear canonical labeling by compressing degree-two paths inside incidence blocks.
results.scope: parameter is the maximum cyclomatic number of an incidence block
